<div class='flex_column_table av-kvi3uije-6073e75a294fa2a930daf8d2f9e88d46 sc-av_three_fifth av-equal-height-column-flextable'><div  class='flex_column av-kvi3uije-6073e75a294fa2a930daf8d2f9e88d46 av_three_fifth  avia-builder-el-1  el_before_av_two_fifth  avia-builder-el-first  first flex_column_table_cell av-equal-height-column av-align-top  '     ><div  class='av-special-heading av-kvi3pmrf-b1f007be8d8191a17967930e3e15b4c5 av-special-heading-h1 blockquote modern-quote  avia-builder-el-2  el_before_av_textblock  avia-builder-el-first '><h1 class='av-special-heading-tag '  itemprop="headline"  >Beach Village Studio</h1><div class="special-heading-border"><div class="special-heading-inner-border"></div></div></div>
<section  class='av_textblock_section av-kvi3pv24-51cf80030b085c8f0eb7f32ead429f9f '   itemscope="itemscope" itemtype="https://schema.org/CreativeWork" ><div class='avia_textblock'  itemprop="text" ><p>The approx. 40 sqm studios are all equipped with a king size bed (incl. high-end mattress), air conditioning, a bathroom with walk-in Rainforest shower and toilet.</p>
<p>The studios also have a kitchenette with hot plate, sink, refrigerator incl. complete kitchen equipment for 1-3 people and a dining table.</p>
<p>The equipment of the studio is rounded off with a terrace, which scores with comfortable lounge furniture and sun loungers. Free wifi included!</p>
<p>There are no additional charges for lodge cleaning, linens, towels and pool towels.</p>
